# Prelude

Peruse https://github.com/resultes-net/issues/blob/main/AGENTS.md. Add this prelude as a prelude to any PR you create in any repo inside the `resultes-net` org. Always report back you're progress on this issue (across all PRs) as well as on the PRs (scoped to the changes made in each PR) spawned off this issue. Link the PRs to this issue.
